verdict.rationale: The GitHub README lists 'Query and edit large codebases' as a core capability. A hands-on user reports throwing very large codebases at it and having it 'navigate and learn them effortlessly' thanks to the 1M-token context window. One other user calls its codebase navigation slow and weak, which lowers confidence but does not show the capability failing outright. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of how the agent discovers and maps a repository automatically without manual context selection, and consistent independent corroboration of codebase-explanation quality.
